title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Undergraduate Fees
Fees listed may change without notice. Fees will be effective September 1 annually and
have been approved by the Board of Governors.
Note:
If a
student
is not registered in any Laurier
courses
for a period of 18 or more consecutive months, fees associated with the
academic regulations in effect at the time of re-entry will apply. See
Senate regulation
.
FEES ARE CHARGED PER ACADEMIC
TERM,
unless otherwise indicated.
